scenes.visual: photo of a close-up of a black car tyre on a silver alloy wheel, car parked on a sunlit Indian city street, low angle from the side at tyre height, deep black rubber with clear tread, the tyre filling the lower middle of the frame, blurred street and shops behind, no logos or text anywhere

narration.en: Why are car *tyres* always black? Here's the thing: they didn't *start* that way.
narration.hi: Car ke *tyre* hamesha kaale hi kyun hote hain? Sach ye hai, shuru mein ye kaale *the hi nahi*.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a tapped rubber tree drips white latex into a cup, then a plain white tyre rolls in, WHITE RUBBER

narration.en: Rubber from the rubber tree is milky *white*. So the very first car tyres were white *too*.
narration.hi: Rubber ke ped se nikalne wala rubber doodh jaisa *safed* hota hai. Isliye pehle car tyre bhi safed *hote the*.

scenes.visual: photo of a vintage 1910s open-top car with thin pale cream-white tyres on wooden spoke wheels, parked inside a museum hall, three-quarter view from the front at low height, the front tyre large in the lower middle of the frame, soft spotlights, dark background, no badges, logos or text anywhere

narration.en: Makers mixed in zinc oxide, but those pale tyres wore out *fast*, often in under *8,000 km*.
narration.hi: Usme zinc oxide milaya jaata tha, par wo tyre jaldi *ghis* jaate the, aksar *8,000 km* se pehle.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: black carbon specks swirl into a spinning white tyre, it turns black, counter 1X to 10X LONGER LIFE

narration.en: Then came *carbon black*, a super-fine soot that's almost pure carbon. Tyres lasted about *ten times* longer.
narration.hi: Phir aaya *carbon black*, ek bahut barik kaalikh jo lagbhag pure carbon hai. Tyre ki life *10 guna* badh gayi.

scenes.visual: photo of a close-up of a black car tyre rolling on a hot asphalt highway in India under harsh midday sun, heat haze shimmering above the road, low angle at road level from the side, the tyre in the lower middle of the frame, bright hazy sky behind, no logos or text anywhere

narration.en: The black also blocks the sun's *UV* rays that crack rubber, and helps spread road *heat* away.
narration.hi: Ye kaala rang dhoop ki *UV* rays ko rokta hai jo rubber ko crack karti hain, aur *garmi* bhi bahar nikalta hai.

scenes.visual: photo of a classic 1950s car with whitewall tyres, black tread and a wide bright white sidewall band, parked on a quiet street at golden hour, side view at wheel height, the front whitewall tyre large in the lower middle of the frame, no badges, logos or text anywhere

narration.en: Carbon black was costly at first, so often only the tread got it. That's where *whitewall* tyres came from.
narration.hi: Shuru mein carbon black mehenga tha, toh aksar sirf tread mein daala jaata tha. Wahin se aaye *whitewall* tyre.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: phone with a black tyre thumbnail, send to a friend, comment NEXT

narration.en: Comment *NEXT* for one more everyday thing nobody ever questions.
narration.hi: Aisi aur rozana ki cheezon ke liye comment mein *NEXT* likho.
